update_interval.label: Update every
update_interval.description: Seconds between samples (1–60). The network charts gain one point per sample.

cpu_fan_number.label: CPU fan number
cpu_fan_number.description: 0 = automatic (a hwmon fan label containing "cpu"). Otherwise pick fan1, fan2, … on the motherboard sensor chip, matching the output of the sensors command.

show_styling.label: Show styling controls
show_styling.description: Reveal the colour, bar, temperature, chart and divider controls. Current values stay active while hidden. Noctalia renders plugin widget settings in one column, so this keeps the default panel short.

show_card_settings.label: Show card settings
show_card_settings.description: Reveal the card title, content width, gap, padding, radius, fill and border controls. Current values stay active while hidden.

show_sections.label: Show section toggles
show_sections.description: Reveal the Show header, network, CPU, RAM, GPU, VRAM, disks, CPU fan and GPU details controls. Their current values stay active while hidden.

show_header.label: Show header
show_header.description: Show the title and settings button above the cards.

show_network.label: Show network
show_network.description: Show the download/upload values and their history charts.

show_cpu.label: Show CPU
show_cpu.description: Show CPU usage, temperature and the optional CPU fan row.

show_ram.label: Show RAM
show_ram.description: Show RAM usage and the segmented memory bar.

show_gpu.label: Show GPU
show_gpu.description: Show GPU usage, temperature and the More details panel. Hides itself behind an explicit "No GPU detected" line when no probe is available.

show_vram.label: Show VRAM
show_vram.description: Show GPU memory usage and the segmented VRAM bar.

show_disks.label: Show disks
show_disks.description: Show one block per physical disk with mounted filesystems, including usage and temperature when the kernel exposes it.

show_cpu_fan.label: Show CPU fan
show_cpu_fan.description: Show the CPU fan row when a fan was found.

allow_gpu_details.label: Allow GPU details
allow_gpu_details.description: Show the More/Less button in the GPU card for junction/memory temperatures, clocks, fan and power.

content_width.label: Content width
content_width.description: Width of the card content in logical px. Match this to the tile width in the desktop-widget editor for a tight fit; the host panel adds its own padding.

card_gap.label: Card gap
card_gap.description: Space between the header and the cards, and between cards.

card_radius.label: Card corner radius
card_radius.description: Corner radius of the inner cards.

card_fill_color.label: Card fill colour
card_fill_color.description: Fill colour of the inner cards. Accepts a hex colour or palette role.

card_fill_opacity.label: Card fill opacity
card_fill_opacity.description: Opacity of the inner-card fill, from 0 (no fill) to 1 (solid).

card_border_color.label: Card border colour
card_border_color.description: Border colour of the inner cards. Accepts a hex colour or palette role.

card_border_width.label: Card border width
card_border_width.description: Border thickness of the inner cards in logical px.

accent_color.label: Accent colour
accent_color.description: Section headings, segmented bar fills, chart lines and normal temperature bars. Accepts a hex colour or palette role.

text_color.label: Primary text colour
text_color.description: Values and titles. Accepts a hex colour or palette role.

muted_text_color.label: Secondary text colour
muted_text_color.description: Labels, units, placeholders and inactive values. Accepts a hex colour or palette role.

track_color.label: Bar track colour
track_color.description: Unfilled part of the segmented bars and the temperature progress track. Accepts a hex colour or palette role.

track_opacity.label: Bar track opacity
track_opacity.description: Opacity of the unfilled bar track, from 0 (invisible) to 1 (solid).

bar_height.label: Bar height
bar_height.description: Height of the segmented bars and the temperature progress bar in logical px.

segment_count.label: Segment count
segment_count.description: Number of segments in the CPU, RAM, GPU and VRAM bars.

segment_gap.label: Segment gap
segment_gap.description: Space between segments in logical px.

temp_warm.label: Warm temperature
temp_warm.description: CPU/GPU temperature (°C) at or above which the warm colour is used.

temp_hot.label: Critical temperature
temp_hot.description: CPU/GPU temperature (°C) at or above which the critical colour and a warning glyph are used. The critical colour wins over the warm colour.

temp_warm_color.label: Warm temperature colour
temp_warm_color.description: Colour of the temperature bar and value between the warm and critical thresholds. Accepts a hex colour or palette role.

critical_color.label: Critical colour
critical_color.description: Colour used for temperatures at or above the critical threshold and for disks at or above the disk warning. Accepts a hex colour or palette role.

disk_warning.label: Disk warning
disk_warning.description: Disk usage percentage at or above which the bar, percentage and warning glyph use the critical colour.

network_chart_height.label: Network chart height
network_chart_height.description: Height of the download chart in logical px. The upload chart is 65% of this height.

network_line_width.label: Chart line width
network_line_width.description: Thickness of the network and CPU/GPU usage chart lines.

network_fill_opacity.label: Chart fill opacity
network_fill_opacity.description: Opacity of the area fill under the network and CPU/GPU usage chart lines.

network_scale_kbps.label: Network chart scale
network_scale_kbps.description: Minimum top of the network chart scale in KB/s. A larger sample raises the scale automatically.

divider_width.label: Divider thickness
divider_width.description: Thickness of the header, GPU details and disk dividers.

divider_color.label: Divider colour
divider_color.description: Colour of the header, GPU details and disk dividers. Accepts a hex colour or palette role.

history_points.label: Chart history
history_points.description: Number of samples kept for the network and CPU/GPU usage charts (10–120).

background.label: Host panel background
background.description: Let Noctalia draw its surface behind the card. Turn off to place the content directly on the desktop wallpaper.

background_color.label: Panel colour
background_color.description: Host panel fill colour. Accepts a hex colour or palette role. Handled by Noctalia, not the plugin.

background_opacity.label: Panel opacity
background_opacity.description: Host panel opacity, applied live by Noctalia without reloading the widget.

background_radius.label: Panel corner radius
background_radius.description: Host panel corner radius in logical px.

background_padding.label: Panel padding
background_padding.description: Space between the host panel edge and the card content in logical px.

usage_chart_height.label: Usage chart height
usage_chart_height.description: Height of the CPU and GPU usage charts in logical px. They share the chart line and fill settings.
